audit_title: POLARIS Stage 8.21A 3D Solar Slant-Path Hydrometeor Geometry Feasibility Audit
final_classification: A. FEASIBILITY VERIFIED — EXPERIMENT MAY BE DESIGNED

F1_3D_Fields_Exist.evidence: meps_det_pl contains 3D q_l and q_i fields on 13 pressure levels.

F2_Causal_Availability.evidence: All 347 origins available from D-1 18Z run with 2.5h publication margin.

F3_Spatial_Coverage.evidence: 25x25 grid window (62.5km) covers max ray displacement of 57.15km at 85° zenith.

F4_Vertical_Structure.evidence: 13 pressure levels allow discrete 3D ray interpolation.

F5_Liquid_Ice_Semantics.evidence: q_l and q_i are separately provided with CF standard mass fraction semantics.

F6_Optical_Proxy_Defensibility.evidence: q_l/q_i are exact, but effective radii r_e must be parameterized (10µm liquid, 30µm ice).

F7_Operational_Tractability.evidence: Total batch volume is ~535 MB, extracted in < 15 min via OPeNDAP.

F8_Information_Novelty.evidence: 3D slant path adds spatial cloud beam intersection, distinct from 1D LWP and Stage 7.5 terrain.

F9_No_Future_Leakage.evidence: Ray geometry relies strictly on causal solar angles and forecast MEPS fields.

decision_summary: Stage 8.21A is technically and scientifically feasible. It provides a novel 3D spatial hydrometeor ray-intersection operator. No model experiment is authorized by this audit.
